name: QuoteMem
description: Auditable long-term memory: saves the conversation in the background, adds relevant memories with their source quotes before the model call, and forgets what the user asks to forget.

captureEvery.description: User turns per saved batch (default 3); "off" disables capture.

recall.description: When to search before the model call (default gated).

recallGate.description: questions (default): plain statements about the user do not search.

maxInjectChars.description: Character budget of the recall block (default 4000); a value below 2500 is raised to 2500.

recallMinScore.description: Relevance (0 to 1) a recalled hit needs; default none (the service's own floor), 0.3 with always. Any number is used as given: at 0 or less every scored hit passes, at 1 or more none does.

forget.description: auto (default): forget requests in chat are carried out silently.

userScope.description: owner (default): one memory, QUOTEMEM_USER_ID, used only by the owner. sender: one memory per channel sender.

ownerSenders.description: With userScope owner: the channel sender ids that are the owner ("<sender id>" or "<channel>:<sender id>"). Messages from other senders get no memory.
